metadata.description: Portable AI-agent skills, measured against the agent without them. ADRs, PRDs, runbooks, decks and reviews, installable into Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro, and any IDE that takes custom instructions. One command per skill or per role-based pack.

plugins.name: skilldrop
plugins.description: Portable AI-agent skills, measured against the agent without them. ADRs, PRDs, runbooks, decks and reviews, installable into Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro, and any IDE that takes custom instructions. One command per skill or per role-based pack.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: The cross-role toolkit every pack builds on: structured intake, document critique, the review council, output hygiene, and the decision graph behind a codebase, plus the ship-a-draft wrapper. Installed automatically with every role pack. (5 skills)

plugins.name: solution-architect
plugins.description: Design-phase artifacts: diagrams, decision records, design docs, contracts, schemas, threat models, and the reviews that gate them. (16 skills)

plugins.name: product-manager
plugins.description: Direction to requirements: PR/FAQs, strategy frameworks, OKRs, business cases, interviews, PRDs, journey maps, and success measurement. (14 skills)

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: Build-and-ship: story splitting, implementation with adversarial review, test plans, triage, pull request descriptions, a ranked technical-debt register, migrations, launch readiness, release notes, agent-policy files, and code-quality gates. (25 skills)

plugins.name: sre-oncall
plugins.description: Operate the service: runbooks, observability design, incident communications, postmortems, and capacity/cost models. (13 skills)

plugins.name: stakeholder-comms
plugins.description: Non-technical audiences: audience profiling, exec summaries, decision logs, and guides. Decks live in the design pack. (9 skills)

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: On-brand visual work: capture a brand once as a brand.json the Word and PowerPoint converters apply, and plan a deck slide by slide for its audience. (7 skills)

plugins.name: ai-engineering
plugins.description: Adopt and build AI systems: readiness assessment, use-case triage, rollout and acceptable-use policy, plus agent loop design, subagent orchestration, spend budgets, agent security review, eval harnesses, and AI-usage reporting. (19 skills)

plugins.name: api-builder
plugins.description: Skills for teams building on the Anthropic API — prompt caching, token budgeting, eval generation for skills, and tool-use schema writing. (4 skills)

plugins.name: converters
plugins.description: Turn Markdown into Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Confluence files that people outside engineering can open, and turn their files back into Markdown. Standard-library Python scripts, with nothing to install. (10 skills)

plugins.name: experience-design
plugins.description: The experience around a product: the structure people navigate, the content and interface words they read, the components they use, and the service behind it all. (11 skills)

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Take a question from vague to answered: plan the research around the decision it serves, synthesise the sources with every claim cited, and rank rival explanations by the evidence against them. (9 skills)

plugins.name: trackers
plugins.description: For leads and PMs who run work in Jira, Linear or GitHub Projects: load a PRD into the tracker, triage the backlog, write the weekly status report, and check the tracker still matches the doc, all from an export or an MCP tool, with the numbers computed rather than estimated. (8 skills)

plugins.name: data-analytics
plugins.description: For analysts and the people who rely on their numbers: review SQL for the bugs that quietly inflate a figure, and spec dashboards around a decision instead of every chart that was easy to make. (7 skills)

plugins.name: grc
plugins.description: Governance, risk and compliance drafts for compliance leads, DPOs and risk owners: a risk register with a checked heat map, a GDPR data protection impact assessment, a SOC 2 control-to-evidence map, and answers to a customer security questionnaire drawn from your own evidence, each prepared for a qualified person to review. (9 skills)

plugins.name: infra-as-code
plugins.description: Terraform you can hand to another team and plans you can trust before apply: reusable modules with secure defaults, and a plan review that catches destroys, data loss, access widening and drift. (7 skills)

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: For frontend engineers and the people who review their pages: read a Lighthouse report for what actually slows the page, find what makes a JavaScript bundle heavy, and choose how each route is rendered from what it needs. (8 skills)

plugins.name: skill-engineering
plugins.description: For people writing Agent Skills in their own repos: write a portable SKILL.md folder from a described task, then audit any skill for routing, portability, safety, structure and evals before you share it. (7 skills)

plugins.name: career
plugins.description: Job applications, for any occupation: a shortlist of which of an employer's roles to go for, an honest check of your resume against the posting, a tailored resume and a cover letter that say nothing you didn't, the application form's answers drafted from your resume, and a script that lists every figure and name in a draft that your own resume doesn't contain. (10 skills)

plugins.name: civil-architect
plugins.description: Building design from a client's room list and a footprint: a schematic floor plan placed at real sizes and drawn as a dimensioned SVG, shown only once a script has checked it for overlapping rooms, rooms outside the footprint, doors on no shared wall, rooms no one can reach and habitable rooms with no window. (6 skills)

plugins.name: operations-manager
plugins.description: Staff rotas from who is available, what each shift needs and the working-time rules: a week or fortnight built and drawn as a grid, shown only once a script has checked every shift's cover and skills, and every person's hours, rest between shifts and days in a row. (6 skills)

plugins.name: event-planner
plugins.description: Seated dinners and event days that hold together: a table plan where every guest has one seat and every together, keep-apart and access request holds, and a run of show where no room or person is booked twice and every changeover has the time it needs, each checked by a script and drawn before anyone prints it. (7 skills)

plugins.name: interior-designer
plugins.description: Furniture plans for one room: every piece at its real size and facing the way it's used, drawn as a dimensioned SVG, and shown only once a script has checked it for overlaps, pieces in a door's swing, blocked bed sides, chair pull-backs and wardrobe doors, and a clear walking route to everything. (6 skills)

plugins.name: startup-legal
plugins.description: Legal groundwork for a startup that can't yet pay a lawyer for everything: an agreement checked before you sign it (blanks, broken cross-references, mismatched amounts, the renewal date, and the clauses that hurt a small company, with wording to ask for), your cap table modelled through SAFEs, notes and a priced round, vesting schedules with leavers, acceleration and the 83(b) deadline, and your first office lease turned into its real commitment and exit dates. Each says what is worth a lawyer's hour. (9 skills)

plugins.name: educator
plugins.description: Assessments that hold up in the exam room and at moderation: an exam paper and its mark scheme checked by a script for totals that don't add up, either/or questions worth different marks, numbering that skips, parts the scheme misses or marks differently, and objectives off their weighting, then read for wording and fairness. (6 skills)
